# CopyMyUI

> CopyMyUI is a moderated marketplace of reusable SwiftUI UI components, with screenshots, source code access (free or premium), categories, creator profiles, favorites, and API-key-based endpoints.

Use locale-prefixed paths for user-facing pages: `/en`, `/es`, `/ru`, `/de`.

Most data pages are public for reading, but user-specific pages and write operations require authentication. Some areas require moderator/admin roles.

## Public Pages

- [Home](/en): Main landing page with featured rails (most favorited, category leaders, newest).
- [Explore Components](/en/components): Searchable/browsable public component catalog.
- [Component Details](/en/components/{slug}): Component screenshots, metadata, and source/purchase state.
- [Category Page](/en/categories/{slug}): Components filtered by category.
- [Creator Profile](/en/creators/{profileSlug}): Public creator profile and their published components.

## User Library Pages

- [Favorites](/en/favorites): Signed-in user's saved components.
- [Purchases](/en/purchases): Signed-in user's unlocked premium components.

## Creator and Operations Pages

- [Creator Dashboard](/en/dashboard): Manage creator submissions and statuses.
- [New Component Draft](/en/dashboard/components/new): Start a new component submission.
- [API Keys Dashboard](/en/dashboard/api-keys): Create/manage personal API keys for v1 endpoints.
- [Moderation](/en/moderation): Moderator review queue and decisions.
- [Admin](/en/admin): Admin controls and system management.
- [Admin Components](/en/admin/components): Admin component-level controls.

## API v1 (API key required)

- [Search Components](/api/v1/search?q=button): Search public components. Optional params include `category`, `access`, and `sort`.
- [My Favorites](/api/v1/favorites): Returns the authenticated user's favorites.
- [My Profile and API Key Context](/api/v1/me): Returns authenticated user summary and API key permissions.

## Authentication and Sessions

- [Sign In](/en/auth/signin): User sign-in page.
- [Auth Routes](/api/auth/[...nextauth]): Authentication handler routes.

## Optional

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/IgorShadurin/CopyMyUI): Project source code and development history.
